note: All branches begin from exactly the same post-A state. Between successive new objects, h always takes the same number of ordinary neutral graph ticks. hold freezes trace values; decay uses the existing learned keep factors without new evidence; evolve lets tags follow actual neutral activations; evolve_all also evolves them for the 4+2 internal commit ticks. Clear only changes traces at input onset. All modes freely commit normal parameters; no external optimizer.
